items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 26:1
items.html: (To the question) What are the GAR of the externality? The Mochin of VAK are called the GAR of the externality, for VAK is called the externality. And GAR is called the internality. See above, Answer 21. (Item 184).
